name: Threads of Snow
source:
You are unable to find sleep in the night, looking at your enchanting lover sleeping on your lap. Yet, in the secretive embrace of the night, you have confessions to make that will change the trajectory of your relationship forever, and ever, and ever.

[from [url=https://butterblanc.itch.io/threads-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
夜深人静，你久久难以成眠，低头凝视着枕在你膝头熟睡的迷人恋人。然而在这隐秘的夜色怀抱之中，你心底藏着几句不得不说的坦白——一旦说出口，你们两人的关系走向便将永远、永远、永远地彻底改变。

[摘自[url=https://butterblanc.itch.io/threads-of-snow]itch.io[/url]]
